verses.text: When Abram was 99, Yahweh appeared to him and said, "I am God Almighty. Live in my presence and be blameless.
I will establish my covenant with you and multiply your family greatly."
Abram fell facedown, and God continued speaking to him:
"Here is my covenant with you: You will become the father of many nations.
Your name will no longer be Abram. It will be Abraham, because I have made you the father of many nations.
I will make you very fruitful. Nations and kings will come from you.
I will establish my covenant with you and your descendants in every generation. It will be an everlasting covenant: I will be your God and the God of your descendants.
I will give you and your descendants the whole land of Canaan, where you now live as foreigners. It will be their lasting possession, and I will be their God."
God said to Abraham, "You must keep my covenant—you and your descendants in every generation.
Here is my covenant with you and your descendants: every male among you must be circumcised.
Circumcise the flesh of your foreskin. This will be the sign of the covenant between us.
Every male who is eight days old must be circumcised in every generation, including those born in your household and those bought with your money from a foreigner who isn't your descendant.
Every male born in your house or bought with your money must be circumcised. My covenant will be marked in your flesh as an everlasting covenant.
Any uncircumcised male who has not been circumcised must be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant."
God said to Abraham, "Don't call your wife Sarai anymore. Her name will be Sarah.
I will bless her and give you a son through her. Yes, I will bless her; she will become the mother of nations, and kings will come from her."
Abraham fell facedown and laughed. He thought, "Can a child be born to a man who's 100? Can Sarah have a baby at 90?"
Abraham said to God, "Please let Ishmael live under your blessing!"
God replied, "No—Sarah your wife will have a son, and you will name him Isaac. I will establish my everlasting covenant with him and his descendants.
As for Ishmael, I have heard you. I have blessed him, and I will make him fruitful and multiply his descendants greatly. He will father 12 princes, and I will make him a great nation.
But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will give birth to at this time next year."
When God had finished speaking with Abraham, he went up from him.
That same day Abraham took his son Ishmael and every male born in his household or bought with his money. He circumcised the flesh of every male in his household, just as God had told him.
Abraham was 99 years old when he was circumcised.
His son Ishmael was 13 when he was circumcised.
On that same day Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised.
Every male in Abraham's household was circumcised with him, both those born in his house and those bought from foreigners.
